title: It's a hoodie. Here's why it's $109.95. (taped note)
hook: It's a hoodie. Here's why it's $109.95.
primary_text:
It's a hoodie. Here's why it's $109.95.
350gsm fleece. Mesh appliqué wordmarks, front and back. Embroidery on both sleeves. A boxy, oversized cut.
That's the lot.
headline: Fair question.
ai_generated: Concrete floor behind the hoodie (Higgsfield, text-to-image, nothing on it). The paper, tape and shadows are drawn in code.
fidelity: Garment pixels match (mean difference 0.47 of 255). 13% of the hoodie is covered by the note on purpose: it sits on the plain lower fleece and hem, and the full back embroidery is visible.
notes_for_owner: The note does not promise that you never discount. The background is AI-generated (the garment is not): TikTok requires its AI-content label, and Meta may add its own. In Ads Manager, switch off Advantage+ creative enhancements for this ad so Meta does not alter the image.
